meta.title: Performance Feedback
meta.flowPosition: after 12 Shift Report & Reflection — mission end
meta.note: Aggregation stage, not a task. Backend-authoritative. Rolls up every LearnerAction across the whole Receiving mission (Screens 06-12) into a competency-based report. This contract defines the SHAPE of that report; the roll-up algorithm itself lives in Flora Backend, matching the backend-authoritative model of every other stage in this pack.

purpose: Flora presents the outcome of the entire Receiving mission as a competency-based assessment — evidence and development recommendations, not a bare pass/fail score — so the learner sees what they demonstrated and what to improve.
learningObjectives: Read and understand a competency-based performance report
Distinguish between completing the mission and demonstrating strong competency
Identify concrete next steps for improvement

input.note: Consumes the full evidenceRef range for the attempt (every LearnerAction emitted from Screen 06 onward) plus the department's competency taxonomy (receiving.department.json → competencies).

expected.evidenceRef: LearnerAction seq range for the whole attempt

rollUp.note: Per-competency score = evidence-weighted aggregate of every LearnerAction across the attempt tagged with that competency (correct vs error/corrected results), computed by Flora Backend. This contract fixes the report shape so any renderer can display it; it does not fix the scoring formula, which is backend-owned like every correctnessModel in this pack.
rollUp.evidenceHighlightsSource: notable ok/error/corrected LearnerActions across all stages, surfaced in chronological order
rollUp.recommendationsSource: competencies scoring below a backend-defined threshold, mapped to a short improvement action

recommendations: Check all pallet labels before scanning

completion.rule: Stage completes when the learner has viewed and acknowledged the feedback report. This is the terminal step of the Receiving mission.
completion.note: No separate correctness model — this stage reports the correctness computed by every prior stage, it does not generate new evidence to score.

output.note: Terminal stage of the Receiving mission. In the department roadmap, mission completion is the trigger to unlock the next department (Put Away).
